lead.headline: OCC Approves Trump Family Crypto Trust Charter as Tokenized Equities Hit 15% Market Share
lead.tldr: Regulatory normalization accelerates with the OCC granting World Liberty Financial a trust charter and Binance plotting UK re-entry, while tokenized equities triple to $2.8B—yet network-level security failures and enforcement actions remind markets that infrastructure and compliance gaps still carry asymmetric downside.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why the regulatory-versus-structural risk trade is repricing faster than most portfolios reflect.

top_signals.title: Harmony plans pre-attack rollback after exploiter forged 3 trillion ONE tokens
top_signals.summary: Harmony is planning a network rollback to recover from a massive exploit where an attacker forged 3 trillion ONE tokens. The protocol determined that a rollback is the most secure and fair method of recovery compared to token burns or wallet blacklisting.

top_signals.title: Alleged $165M crypto Ponzi mastermind faces US charges after Fiji deportation
top_signals.summary: Edward Zimbardi has been deported from Fiji to the United States to face 25 federal charges. He is accused of orchestrating a cryptocurrency Ponzi scheme that defrauded investors of over $165 million.

top_signals.title: OCC approves Trump family crypto company for trust charter
top_signals.summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) has approved a trust charter for the Trump family's crypto venture, World Liberty Financial. Despite concerns regarding potential conflicts of interest, the OCC stated that the approval process adhered to statutory duties and ethical obligations.

top_signals.title: Tokenized equities triple market share as Ondo, Binance and xStocks dominate
top_signals.summary: The tokenized equities market has experienced significant growth, with its market share tripling since the start of the year to reach 15%. The total market capitalization for these assets is now approximately $2.8 billion.

top_signals.title: Binance to plan UK relaunch with FCA license application: Report37m, Binance to plan UK relaunch with FCA license application: ReportBinance’s UK arm has been barred from offering regulated activities in the country since June 2021, but the company will reportedly move to secure licensing under new crypto rules.
top_signals.summary: Binance is reportedly planning to relaunch its operations in the UK by applying for a license from the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA). This move follows a period since June 2021 where the exchange was barred from offering regulated activities in the region.

deals.summary: QuantumLight, a venture capital firm co-founded by Revolut CEO Nik Storonsky, has successfully closed its second fund. The fund has raised a total of $500 million to support its investment activities.

MicroStrategy raised approximately $333.7 million through the sale of 3.46 million shares. Unlike previous equity raises, the proceeds were used for dividends, share repurchases, and USD reserves rather than purchasing additional Bitcoin.

on_the_radar.title: Andreessen Horowitz focus of DOJ probe over board directors
on_the_radar.summary: The Department of Justice is conducting a probe into Andreessen Horowitz regarding its board directors. The investigation comes as the venture capital firm has closely aligned itself with the second Trump administration.

on_the_radar.title: US Treasury seeks public comment on GENIUS Act stablecoin rules
on_the_radar.summary: The US Treasury is seeking public feedback on rules regarding the GENIUS Act, which governs the issuance of payment stablecoins. The act mandates that entities must obtain federal or state licenses to issue stablecoins within the United States.

on_the_radar.title: Bitmine nears 5% of Ethereum supply despite $8.4B in unrealized losses13m, Bitmine nears 5% of Ethereum supply despite $8.4B in unrealized lossesTom Lee’s Ethereum treasury company keeps buying the second-biggest crypto through the downturn, while more than 5 million staked ETH is projected to generate $287 million in annual rewards.
on_the_radar.summary: Bitmine, led by Tom Lee, continues to accumulate Ethereum despite facing $8.4 billion in unrealized losses, now approaching 5% of the total ETH supply. The company's strategy focuses on long-term holding and staking, with over 5 million ETH expected to generate $287 million in annual rewards.

on_the_radar.title: Bitmine adds 9,926 ETH, taking total holdings to roughly $11 billion
on_the_radar.summary: Bitmine has increased its Ethereum holdings by 9,926 ETH, bringing its total treasury to approximately 5.82 million tokens. The company's total holdings are now valued at roughly $11 billion.

on_the_radar.title: Bitcoin miner HIVE inks five-year $350 million AI cloud contract, adds $70 million in annualized revenue
on_the_radar.summary: Bitcoin miner HIVE has secured a five-year GPU cloud contract worth $350 million through its BUZZ HPC division. This agreement will add $70 million in annualized recurring revenue to the company.

on_the_radar.title: Bitpanda fined in Austria’s first published MiCA penalty21m, Bitpanda fined in Austria’s first published MiCA penaltyThe FMA said Bitpanda breached MiCA rules on crypto white papers and marketing communications, with the decision now final.
on_the_radar.summary: The Austrian Financial Market Authority (FMA) has issued a fine to Bitpanda, marking the first published penalty under the Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation. The penalty stems from breaches regarding crypto white papers and marketing communications.

on_the_radar.title: Robinhood Chain TVL surges 45% in August as tokenized RWAs lose ground
on_the_radar.summary: Robinhood Chain experienced a 45% surge in Total Value Locked (TVL) during August. This growth was primarily driven by stablecoin inflows, specifically USDe, while tokenized real-world assets saw a decline.

on_the_radar.title: IREN delivers first of four AI cloud deployments to Microsoft under $9.7 billion deal
on_the_radar.summary: IREN has delivered the first of four AI cloud deployments to Microsoft as part of a $9.7 billion deal. The company is strategically pivoting its infrastructure away from Bitcoin mining toward AI cloud capacity.

worth_a_read.title: Exclusive: Nik Storonsky’s VC firm closes $500m for second fund
worth_a_read.note: The Storonsky fund close is worth tracking for where Revolut-derived capital deploys in fintech-crypto overlap, particularly given the firm's algorithmic sourcing model.

worth_a_read.title: The State of Crypto Leverage – Q2 2026: An Orderly, Measured Decline
worth_a_read.note: Galaxy's leverage report likely contains the only systematic data on whether DeFi and CeFi leverage contraction is orderly or masking forced unwinds beneath headline stability.

worth_a_read.title: Does it make sense for Revolut to get physical?
worth_a_read.note: The Revolut physical branches question probes whether digital-native fintechs are conceding that customer acquisition costs require hybrid touchpoints—a relevant analog for crypto on-ramp strategies.

linkedin_post:
The OCC approved World Liberty Financial for a national trust charter. Same week, Binance is back at the FCA's door asking for UK admission. The pattern is not subtle: regulators are reopening onshore access, but selectively, and with a tolerance for political proximity that was not the case eighteen months ago.

We underwrite tokenized equities at 15% market share and $2.8B because that growth is measurable and has issuer names attached—Ondo, Binance, xStocks. The value is shifting from speculative tokens to regulated wrappers of real assets. That is a repricing we can model.

What we cannot model is whether a network that rolls back 3 trillion forged tokens retains any credible decentralization claim. Harmony's recovery plan is a stress test for a governance assumption many chains still carry on their balance sheets as an intangible asset.

The Zimbardi extradition from Fiji to face $165M Ponzi charges? That extends the enforcement perimeter. Offshore is not off-limits anymore. The cost of jurisdictional opacity just went up.

Our read: regulated infrastructure is getting repriced upward faster than the underlying assets. The trade is not crypto versus tradfi. It is compliant versus non-compliant access layers. One of those just got a trust charter.

What would kill this thesis: if the FCA rejects Binance or the OCC charter faces judicial reversal. Both are trackable.
